config.home: throwaway HOME and WAKU_HOME (state.db, MEMORY.md, outbox, traces), TZ=UTC, WAKU_* and API keys unset
config.turn_tool: gate retrieve 'alex' (empty memory); save_note(subject 'alex', content: a 4790-character agenda); reply
config.turn_limit: max_iterations 2: gate retrieve 'alex' (finds the note); manage_memory search 'alex'; send_message to Alex; limit hit, one tools-off final call
config.turn_consolidate: gate skip; plain reply; consolidation due (6 unconsolidated rows): 2 facts proposed, 1 an ops fact that is dropped; 1 episode
config.graph_quick: graph_workflows on: triage says quick; quick reply
config.graph_full: graph_workflows on: triage says full; gate retrieve 'alex'; plain reply
config.graph pool: first wave run one node at a time on pool threads, in submit order (see SKIPS)
